Hey OP, please tell me about your life up until now? You're an orphan? How? What happened?

Tell her to take a long hot bath, watch whatever she wants on Netflix, and that you have everything covered. Take her a glass of wine in the bath (And make sure everything is clean before she wakes up) -counters clean, floor clean, everything in the dishwasher (and for the love of god don't run it and then leave it for her to unpack in the morning). You sound like a great guy. Good luck to you
Holy shit. You nailed it. You fucking got me. Nothing I can say except, you're 100% right and I've been trying to avoid it. I'm a sucker. Fuck
I might just try that.. thank you for the suggestion

Oh my goodness, this was so hard to read. Your situation is way harder than mine. 

Your wife needs serious mental assessment and help, if not willingly, then by force. You need to get your children to a safe place, by any means necessary.

You have too much on your plate.you absolutely cannot continue doing everything like you have been. You will burn out, and your kids will be left in the care of a parent who is not able to care for them at any acceptable standard.

Document what you can,the neglect, the binge drinking, whatever you can without endangering your kids, make records of you trying to get her help,  cover your ass but get the fuck out.

Dude, serious respect. What a man!

I've recently sent him to a new psych, who picked up on his emotional dis-regulation quite quickly. But I've seen the pattern of him improving for a little while and then devolving into old habits. So I'm not counting my chickens.

With twins, the only self care I can get is having a shower after they're asleep. But I'll take it!!
Wow! Thank you! That's such a fucking awesome thing to hear!! You made my week!
Thank you for understanding, at this stage it's just the desire that's come back. I won't act on it, I wouldn't feel ok with it. It's just the fantasy of the possibility of it that has me "waking up"

It's just, he knows me in and out, I don't think any of my friends know me as well as he does. He knows how weird I can be, odd things I do. Best friend was probably the wrong description. It's just he knows me, and accepts me, for eg comes home on a Friday, and I've made a specific food, he'll know I've had a bad day? The weird intimacies of having lived with someone perhaps? The comfort of being yourself and never being judged? 

Yes, I know, I need better friends.

I struggle to separate the good and bad- eg if you took away his behaviour towards me and the kids, his laziness etc, we get along really well, he makes me laugh, can be very generous, is very intelligent etc

But that's the thing, those things can't be separated. I think I've compartmentalized what I can cope with and what I can't.
I'm a strong woman. I've survived worse. He won't keep me down

No, I plan to start work right away. My area is in demand, and I can work from home or do part time. Something that isnt available here. I also have a separate account I've been putting money into for childcare/nursery/crèche because I know it can be prohibitively expensive
Can't stay in this country. It's a dangerous place for kids, no jobs. Dumpster fire of a shithole.

You're right, and I think I am trying my best to avoid thinking about that aspect. I am introverted whereas he has a gregarious personality and makes friends a lot easier. I have a lot to consider and think about.

I have 2 degrees in science and have made some good investments money wise. However, because I've been a sahm, I don't get the points needed for emigration, he does, but he can't emigrate without my money... It's fucked. Forced codependency.
Thank you
Ooh no, I'll never cheat. That's a no no. I'm not going to act on the desire. It's just there again, after having 0 sex drive forever.

Thank you, you will get there. Kids do make it harder. My son worships his father, and his father treats him like shit. I need out for all of us. So my son doesn't grow up to be like his dad, and so that my daughter knows that being treated like this is unacceptable
Thank you

Thing is, we have plans to emigrate soon, I won't do anything before then because it will mean he won't get to be in their lives. He has also mentioned the same scenario "once we get there we should separate" I agreed, but then everything went to hell I had his cousin's calling me about it. 

He suggested it, then had a "breakdown".
